## Appearance

Jane Andrews is described as plain in her appearance. She maintains a neat and sensible look.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Plain, plodding, and conscientious, Jane Andrews is characterized by her unshakeable composure and pragmatic nature. She is driven by a desire for wealth and luxury, such as diamonds, yet remains focused on her practical goals. Her primary ambitions are to earn her salary fairly, satisfy school trustees, earn a spot on the School Inspector's roll of honor, and devote her entire life to teaching without ever marrying.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P47](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 IV Different Opinions P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)_

## History

During her schooldays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Jane Andrews was a member of the local "[Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club)" alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and other classmates. As a young adult, she attended a summer concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md), riding home with her brother [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) after the event. Years later, Jane met with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and proposed to her on behalf of [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md); after [Anne](../character/anne.md) declined the offer, Jane coolly accepted the refusal, noting that her brother would likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P4](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P7](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P8](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P9](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0009), +456 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are close playmates and long-standing friends. They spend time together attending school events, social gatherings, and traveling to concerts.

- Friend of — playmates and close friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P40](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0040), [v3 ch.Proposal P1](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0001), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--jane-andrews.md)

Jane and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are close school friends who regularly share books and join in social activities. Jane visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) during her recovery from a broken ankle, and the two travel together to outings such as the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) concert.

- Friend of — classmates who lend books to each other  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), +2 more</sub>

### [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is Billy's sister, and she frequently accompanies him on social outings, including drives to local concerts. She acts as an intermediary for her shy brother, even proposing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on his behalf during an overnight stay. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) declines, Jane accepts the rejection coolly and matter-of-factly notes that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry someone else.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Proposal P13](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0013)</sub>
